title: One-Time Password / PIN Solicitation
description: Message prompts the recipient to share or enter an OTP or security PIN.

title: High Urgency Coercion
description: Message uses panic or urgency words (immediately, suspended, blocked, 24h, expire).

title: Financial / Banking Lure
description: Message references bank accounts, credit cards, prizes, lotteries, or KYC verification.

title: Unsolicited Link in Urgent Context
description: Message embeds an external link paired with urgency or account verification demands.
